stemMd: Why does the author say not every voyage detail must be reproduced?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To excuse ignoring major load differences.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To claim all comparisons are equally reliable.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To distinguish a useful controlled comparison from an impossible demand for perfect identity.

options.label: E
options.textMd: To prove the coating caused no savings.

explanationMd: The passage calls for practical control of important variables, not exact duplication of every circumstance. This makes the demand for evidence reasonable while preserving attention to confounding factors.

distractorRationale.a: The sentence says major relevant differences should be addressed.
distractorRationale.c: The passage specifies what makes a comparison useful.
distractorRationale.e: The effect remains an open question.
distractorRationale.b: The operator asks for better and longer records.
